title: The McMillan Running Calculator — Using Your Training Paces
claims: The calculator predicts equivalent race performances at other distances from a recent race time and provides optimal training pace ranges.
Training is divided into four zones: Endurance Workouts, Stamina Workouts, Speed Workouts and Sprint Workouts.
Each zone lists pace ranges for specific workouts, alongside %HRmax, %heart-rate reserve and RPE.
The guide describes its equivalent performances as estimates whose accuracy depends on course, weather and day-to-day condition.
It states that race distances close together are more predictive than distances far apart, and that a 5 km runner is unlikely to run the equivalent marathon time without marathon training.
It recommends recalculating paces every 4–8 weeks as fitness changes.
The calculator and pace ranges are a commercial coaching service, not a governing-body or clinical standard.
